description: Initialize flotknot variables in the range. Values that can be set include pore-pressure, temperature, extra. Note that the [flowknotinitializeoptions] is available after each of the following keywords, allowing them to be varied in space independently.
notes: '[flowknotinitializeoptions]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (add, gradient, multiply, vary).

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: Set initial flowknot extra variable values.

keywords.name: add
keywords.description: Add the specified value to the existing value.

keywords.name: gradient
keywords.description: Apply a gradient to the scalar-value provided.

keywords.name: multiply
keywords.description: Multiply the existing value by the specified value.

keywords.name: vary
keywords.description: Apply a linear variation to the scalar-value provided.
